title: Pembroke Castle
identityStatus: Exact Q1422235 named point. Nearby named/mapped castle components are separately associated from primary photographs and plans; none is claimed as an exact-QID complete footprint.

keep.basis: Operator information-pack indexed text:25m high and16m diameter; Cadw confirms domed roof and over22m height. Own mapped circle locates center; published16m diameter overrides slight map-span difference. Dome and wall dimensions are estimates.

towers.basis: Own three-point fit to mapped round exterior arc. Crown heights, wall thickness and crenellations are original photographic estimates.

portal.basis: Own mapped oblique building-passage route; width,height,shape and wall reveals are photographic estimates.

barbican.basis: Original low curved forework interpretation from official aerial views; it is not a surveyed/map-derived ring.

halls.basis: Mapped north wall23086736 and adjacent ruin/solar lines guide original roofless rectangular hall envelope; depth, height and apertures estimated.
Mapped walls23086575/23086912 and official photographs; complete hollow envelope and window detail are original estimates.

dungeon.basis: Original round-front tower and latrine mass interpretation of mapped inner-ward walls and official photos. Map does not resolve the complete curved tower exterior.

westernHall.basis: Original open western hall envelope from primary photographs and nearby mapped wall traces. Composite mapped wall23086737 is retained as evidence but not filled as a solid room.

stAnne.basis: Restored residence over narrow projection, based on approximate mapway23086573. Current height/roof and turret shapes need site review.

wogan.basis: Dinnis et al2023: approx23m north-south,18m east-west,max5m high,floor9–10m aboveOD, north-facing walled mouth beneath GreatHall. Local chamber outline, mouth angle and doors/windows are original estimates; coarse DEM conflicts with this vertical section.

greatMap.basis: Modern visitor map is represented by original schematic island geometry with palette colors, not copied artwork or a unique photo texture.

nativeAxes.front: Oblique southeastern main entrance, baked in East/South coordinates
nativeAxes.origin: Wikidata reference coordinate; original plateauY15 attachment plane over native datum2.5m. Cliff and Wogan descend below it.

reconstruction.scope: Present-day exterior interpretation: circular domed keep, offset gatehouse, hollow wall towers, mostly lost inner gate footings, roofless Great/Norman/western halls, StAnne residence, Wogan mouth/chamber, promontory, paths and schematic modern GreatMap.
reconstruction.basis: Own attributed map coordinates, original interpretation of primary Cadw/operator/RCAHMW imagery, cave dimensions from primary published excavation research. No downloaded model, traced drawing or photo texture.
reconstruction.referenceState: Original estimates for present-day restored/ruined components; transient event tents omitted.
